name: construction
description: URL plan + content map template for general contractors and residential construction companies (remodeling, new construction, roofing, siding, decks, painting). Targets local-commercial project-based search intent with dense city x service cross-product pages.
notes: Construction is overwhelmingly local_commercial project intent — homeowners researching contractors weeks or months before hiring. Plan defaults reflect that.
Cross-product pages (/service-areas/{city}/{service}/) are the primary SEO lever in this vertical and are enabled by default.
Construction clients typically run standard weekday business hours. Never plan copy that implies around-the-clock dispatch; lead with free estimates, licensing, and craftsmanship instead.
Repair-oriented services (water damage, storm damage, mold) are framed as repair/renovation capabilities of a general contractor, not rapid-dispatch response services.
